title: 7 Marks of a Godly Friendship
caption:
7 marks of a godly friendship. Not the group chat that only shows up when it's convenient.

He asks the question you were hoping nobody would ask. He knows what you're actually wrestling with, not just what you post. He tells you the truth even when it costs the mood, Proverbs calls that faithful. He shows up on the Tuesday, not just the crisis. He remembers what you confessed and never uses it against you. He calls you when you've gone quiet. And he'd rather lose the friendship than watch you lose yourself.

That's the line that separates a friend from an audience.
